title: Japanese-Style Chaat Pasta
description: A unique fusion dish that combines the flavors of Japan with the popular Indian street food, chaat. This Japanese-Style Chaat Pasta is a creative take on traditional pasta dishes.

ingredients.name: tagliatelle
ingredients.notes: use a Japanese-style soba noodle for a more authentic taste

instructions: Cook the tagliatelle according to package instructions.
In a large pan, heat the soy sauce, sushi vinegar (if using), and sesame oil over low heat.
Add the chaat and stir to combine.
Add the tender and stir to combine.
Add the cooked tagliatelle to the pan and toss to combine.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and garnish with chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds (if using).
